<thought>To find the template that reproduces the Doebner modification, I will search the retrosynthetic template catalog for a reaction that breaks a carboxylic acid, forms an alkene, breaks a C=O bond, and forms a C=C bond. I’ll use a simple cinnamic acid SMILES (c1ccc(C=CC(=O)O)cc1) as the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "c1ccc(C=CC(=O)O)cc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["carboxylic_acid"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["alkene"],
    "bonds_broken": ["6-8"],
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6"]
}</action_input>
